p.title: v60.02 a universe review dated a day ahead of the reader's clock no longer empties the screener
p.symptom: With lastBulkUpdate set to the review day, a clock behind that date (a fixed test clock at the previous evening, a reader in an earlier time zone or with a slow clock) saw every screener row unusable and '조건에 맞는 종목이 없습니다'; plan 048's executor had to back-date the review to make a browser gate pass.
p.root_cause: classifyFieldStatus returned STALE for any observation dated after `now`, including the identity fields whose date is the curated list's review day, and the provider's universe status required now >= the review date while the legacy flag did not.
p.fix: src/data/contracts/screener.js: the future-date rule does not apply to reference-cadence fields; src/data/providers/screener.js: the universe is STALE only when its age exceeds the window. lastBulkUpdate is the real review day (2026-11-13).
p.violated_rule: A review date is not a market observation; clock skew must not remove content (P1542 class).
p.prevention: ci-screener-extended-browser-check runs with a fixed clock one evening before the review date and renders rows; the workbench contract keeps the identity budget test.
p.verification: ci-screener-extended-browser-check exit 0 with lastBulkUpdate 2026-11-13 (exit 1 before the fix); workbench, unit and lookahead gates exit 0.

changelog: **A review dated ahead of the clock no longer empties the screener ({P}):** reference dates are not treated as future observations.
note: v60.02: reference dates tolerate clock skew
